# Frontal CLI

> Command-line interface for the Frontal platform. Wraps `@frontal-labs/sdk@1.0.4`; no raw HTTP. Project config lives in `frontal.jsonc`. Machine-readable output with `--json`; errors go to stderr as `{"error":{code,message,fix,docs,requestId,statusCode}}` with stable exit codes (0 ok, 1 general, 2 validation, 3 auth, 4 permission, 5 not found, 6 config, 10 network, 11 timeout, 12 rate limited).

Version: frontal-cli@0.1.2. Verify with `frontal --version`.

## Rules for agents

- Prefer `--json` and read stdout; errors are on stderr. Never parse human output.
- Credentials: `--api-key frt_…` or `FRONTAL_API_KEY`; `.env.local` in the project is read automatically. Never print keys — the CLI redacts them, do not work around that.
- `frontal <command> --help` always contains an `Examples:` block.
- Config files may contain comments and trailing commas (`frontal.jsonc`).
- Set `FRONTAL_CONFIG_DIR` to a scratch directory in sandboxes so `~/.frontal` is untouched.

## Commands

- `frontal init [--name <dir>] [--force]`: create `frontal.jsonc`, `.env.example`, `.gitignore` entries (`.frontal/`, `.env`, `.env.local`), `src/.gitkeep`, and `package.json` if missing. Never overwrites without `--force`. `--json` returns `{dir,name,created,updated,skipped,kept}`.
- `frontal dev [--port 8787] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--scenario <name>] [--remote a,b] [--persist-to <dir>] [--no-watch]`: local Frontal API for the project, no key needed. Serves `agents`, `graph`, `datasets`, `blob`, `workers`, `observability`, `governance` and `auth/account/profile` from fixtures persisted in `.frontal/state/<namespace>/<id>.json`; `GET /health` always local; `--scenario` loads `.frontal/scenarios/<name>.json` (`{ routes: [{ method, path, status?, body?, headers?, times? }] }`, `path` starting with `^` is a regex; scenario routes override built-ins); `--remote` proxies listed services through the SDK (needs credentials, adds `X-Frontal-Dev-Proxy`); unknown paths return 404 with a `fix` hint; live-reloads config/scenario files; `--json` emits NDJSON `{type: ready|request|reload|stopped}`. Point the SDK at `http://localhost:8787/v1`.
- `frontal types [--out src/frontal-configuration.d.ts] [--env <name>]`: generate `FrontalEnv`, `FrontalVars`, `FrontalSecrets`, `FrontalServices` (typed SDK client per enabled service via `import("@frontal-labs/sdk").Frontal`), `FrontalProject`; augments `NodeJS.ProcessEnv`. Header `// Generated by frontal types — do not edit.` `--json` returns `{out,changed,services,vars,secrets}`.
- `frontal env pull [file=.env.local] [--env <name>] [--force]`: write `.env.local` from `frontal.jsonc` (`FRONTAL_API_URL` from `apiUrl`, `secrets.required` placeholders, `vars`) plus `FRONTAL_API_KEY` from the active credential; refuses to touch an existing file without `--force`, which merges and keeps existing values. `--json` → `{file, written, preserved, missing}`. Values are never printed.
- `frontal env push [file=.env.local] [--env <name>]`: validates `secrets.required`, verifies the credential (`GET /auth/account/profile`), then redeploys the current deployment (`POST /workers`, `env_vars` = `vars` + file entries except `FRONTAL_API_KEY`/`FRONTAL_API_URL`). Errors: `ENV_FILE_MISSING`, `MISSING_SECRETS` (2), `NO_DEPLOYMENT` (6, run `frontal deploy` first). `--json` → `{deployment, keys, requestId}`.
- `frontal logs [--follow] [--filter <query>] [--since 15m] [--level <l>] [--limit 100]`: `POST /observability/logs/query` (default query `project:<name>`, ISO `timeFrom`, `order: asc`); `--follow` streams `GET /observability/logs/stream` (SSE) with exponential reconnect (500ms→10s) on transport errors, stops on Ctrl+C, aborts immediately on 401/403. `--json` = NDJSON entries (+ `{"type":"reconnect"}` lines); `--filter` is sent server-side and applied client-side as a substring fallback.
- `frontal policy check [--strict] [--user <id>] [--role <name>...] [--env <name>]`: validates `.frontal/policies/*.{json,rego,cel}` via `POST /policies/validate`, lists active policies, runs `POST /access/check` (action `deploy`) for every service in `frontal.jsonc` as the current identity (`GET /auth/account/profile`, or `--user/--role`), reads `GET /compliance/score` (warn < 70). Prints `✓/!/✗ rule — reason` + `fix:`; exit 1 on any deny; `--strict` turns warnings into denies. `--json` → `{passed, policyId, userId, strict, summary:{pass,warn,deny}, ruleResults:[{ruleId, result, passed, reason, fix}]}`.
- `frontal deploy [--preview|--prod] [--yes] [--dry-run] [--outdir <dir>] [--env <name>]`: bundles `entry` from `frontal.jsonc` (default `src/index.ts`) with `bun build` (in-process under Bun, `bun build` CLI under Node → `BUNDLER_UNAVAILABLE` if Bun is missing) into `<outdir>/index.js` + `manifest.json` (name, env, target, sha, size, vars, state *schema* only). `--dry-run` stops there (no network). Otherwise `POST /workers` as `<name>-preview` (default) or `<name>` (`--prod`, needs `--yes` non-interactively → `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`). Prints `<apiUrl>/workers/<name>` + request id; records `.frontal/state/deploys/<id>.json` (+ `current-<env>`, `current-<env>-<target>`) with an immutable artifact copy in `.frontal/artifacts/<sha>/`. `--json` → `{dryRun, target, sha, size, manifest, record?}`.
- `frontal promote <url|id>`: re-`POST /workers` the recorded preview artifact under the prod name; no rebuild. Errors `DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND`, `ARTIFACT_MISSING` (5).
- `frontal rollback [url|id]`: re-deploys the previous production record (or the given one) and calls `POST /agents/{id}/rollback` for every id in `frontal.jsonc` `agents` (per-agent failures are reported, not fatal). `NO_ROLLBACK_TARGET` (5) when there is nothing older. `--json` → record + `agents:[{agentId, version|error}]`.
- `frontal auth login [--method browser|api-key] [--auth-url <url>]`: browser PKCE login or validated API key; stores into the active profile.
- `frontal auth password-login --email <e> --password <p>` / `frontal auth signup --email <e> --password <p>`: public auth API (no credentials needed).
- `frontal auth whoami [--local]`: local credential status plus `GET /auth/account/profile`; `--local` skips the API.
- `frontal auth logout` / `frontal auth token` / `frontal auth refresh`: manage the stored session.
- `frontal auth mfa <status|setup|enable --code|disable --code|verify --code|backup-codes-regenerate>`.
- `frontal config <set <k> <v>|get <k>|list|reset|profiles|use <profile>|telemetry>`: `~/.frontal/config.json` profiles.
- `frontal workflows list [--limit --cursor]` / `create --body <json>` (validated against the SDK `WorkflowDefinitionSchema`) / `search --body` / `batch --body` / `run get <wf> <run>` / `run summary <wf> <run>` / `run timeline <wf> <run>` (SSE; `--json` emits NDJSON lines `{type,data,id}`).
- `frontal runs <list|create --body>`; `frontal invocations create --body`; `frontal events <list|get <id>|query --body|usage --body|reprocess --body>`.
- `frontal completion <bash|zsh|fish>`; `frontal migrate-legacy`.

## Global flags

`--json`, `--yaml`, `--quiet`, `--verbose` (or `FRONTAL_DEBUG=1`), `--debug`, `--env <dev|staging|prod>`, `--api-key`, `--api-url`, `--profile`, `--yes`, `--no-color`, `--watch [s]`, `--until field=value`.

## frontal.jsonc

```jsonc
{ "$schema": "https://frontal.dev/schemas/frontal.jsonc", "name": "my-app", "env": "dev", "entry": "src/index.ts",
  "apiUrl": "https://api.frontal.dev/v1",
  "services": { "ai": { "remote": false }, "agents": { "remote": false }, "graph": { "remote": false } },
  "vars": {}, "secrets": { "required": ["FRONTAL_API_KEY"] } }
```

Valid service keys: agents, ai, audit, auth, billing, blob, connectors, data, datasets, events, governance, graph, integrations, lineage, observability, ontology, pipelines, sandbox, schedules, webhooks, workers, workflows. Overlay files `frontal.<env>.jsonc` are deep-merged with `--env`.
